capabilities: Show comment count badges on mind map nodes
Resolve, reopen and review comments from the map
Filter badges by status and category
Jump to the next or previous node with comments
Start a comment on a node via Annoteca's form
disambiguation: It does not create or edit mind maps; it only overlays Annoteca comment badges on the Mind map editor plugin's map.
extras: Not made by Mind map editor's author; it reads the map externally, so badges switch off if a Mind map editor release changes what it reads. Explains why inline comment storage can be damaged by map edits and offers conversion to end-of-file storage. No network requests; support via Discord and GitHub issues.
intentEvidence: This plugin connects two other plugins. You need both:
problem: Mind map editor shows nothing about Annoteca comments, so comment activity is invisible and hard to act on while working on a map.

relations.evidence: Annoteca 1.20.0 or later, for the comments.
It reads Mind map editor's map from the outside

summary: Bridge that shows Annoteca comment badges on Mind map editor nodes and lets you create, resolve and navigate comments from the map.
